reviews.text: They are fabulous, the treatment of the animals is fantastic and the service is beyond compare. I've been a client for over 20 years, I currently live in Montijo and they continue to be our veterinarian for our pets.

Excellent experience at Urvet! Dr. Luís Neves and Dr. Mariana are extremely professional, attentive, and show great affection for the animals. Gisela, the veterinary assistant, is always very friendly and efficient, making everything even more pleasant. I highly recommend them!

Dr. Luís performs tail amputations on dogs, which is prohibited by law! They don't use a prescription for this procedure to avoid leaving a trace.
I witnessed it with my own eyes!
If you want to know if it's true, I suggest you pretend to take a puppy to have this procedure done and record what you are told.
Excellent veterinarians, very humane, and a very helpful receptionist. Thankful for everything.

Not good, dont come here!
They just want the money and dont care about the animals...

Best veterinarian in Lisbon! Fair, professional, friendly and humane. The team, consisting of Dr. Luís, Dr. Mariana and veterinary assistant Gisela, are exceptionally dedicated. Fair prices, considering animal welfare and the financial possibilities of pet owners. I wouldn't trade them for any other!!
Dr. Luis Neves is extremely competent. I recommend him!

Clinic in the Benfica area, I've been a client for over 20 years. Highly recommended, veterinarian with a lot of experience, highly competent. Accurate diagnoses and always with quick action. Able to explain the reason for all procedures before administering them to the pets. The owner's opinion always prevails.
Service and care of high reliability.
